title: populus deltoides var. wislizeni
intro: Populus deltoides var. wislizeni, commonly known as Fremont cottonwood, is a deciduous tree species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which provide several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Fremont cottonwood include wound healing, pain relief, and digestive support, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents present in this plant also contribute to its potential to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress.
